rawFindings.title: Windows drive paths using forward slashes are no longer recognized as absolute
rawFindings.explanation: This absolute-path check now only accepts drive-letter paths followed by a backslash. Windows also treats paths like `C:/tmp/file.txt` as absolute, but `utils.isAbsolute('C:/tmp/file.txt')` now returns a falsy value. Callers that require an absolute path, such as `res.sendFile`, will incorrectly reject valid Windows absolute paths written with forward slashes.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the forward-slash case, e.g. `if (':' === path[1] && ('\\' === path[2] || '/' === path[2])) return true;`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: On Windows, `res.sendFile('C:/tmp/example.txt')` without a `root` option is rejected as non-absolute instead of serving the absolute file path.
